_scope: Hyperspace is not ported yet, so the denominator is only the shared C++
core that already compiles without a GL context.
Hyperspace/*.cpp   the simulation still calls OpenGL directly
HyperspaceView.mm  AppKit/NSOpenGLView; needs a host process
As the port replaces those with testable code, move them into sources --
the ratchet will hold whatever coverage they arrive with.
Note the include style: this repo uses <rsMath/rsMath.h>, so the repo root
is on the include path rather than each source directory.
OpenGL is linked because this repo's Implicit/impSurface.cpp still calls it
from draw() and the destructor. Helios de-GL'd its copy of that same file
during its port; the two have diverged. Drop the framework once hyperspace
is ported, or once the shared core is extracted and unified.
